name: subapplicationId
desc: Single-value that uniquely identifies the subapplication/subgrant. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: projectSiteInventoryId
desc: Single value that uniquely identifies the project site inventory location. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: projectSiteInventoryType
desc: Type of project site inventory (i.e., Building, Vacant land, Utility/Infrastructure/Other). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: primaryActivity
desc: Primary mitigation activity associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Acquisition, Elevation, Flood Mitigation, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: secondaryActivity
desc: Secondary mitigation activity associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Acquisition, Elevation, Flood Mitigation, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: primaryHazard
desc: Primary hazard associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Flooding, Fire, Tornado, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO, NEMIS]

name: secondaryHazard
desc: Secondary hazard associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Flooding, Fire, Tornado, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO, NEMIS]

name: city
desc: Name of the City associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Chicago). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: countyCode
desc: Identifier assigned to the County or County equivalent associated with the project site inventory (e.g., 031 represents Cook County). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: county
desc: Name of the County or County equivalent associated with the project site inventory (e.g., Cook County). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: stateCode
desc: Identifier assigned to the State associated with the project site inventory (e.g., 17 represents Illinois). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: stateAbbreviation
desc: Two letter abbreviation of the State (e.g., IL represents Illinois) associated with the project site inventory. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: zipcode
desc: Five digit ZIP Code associated with the project site inventory (e.g., 60614). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: structureType
desc: Type of structure (e.g., Government, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: structurePrimarySubtype
desc: Primary subtype of structure (e.g., Emergency Response, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: structureSecondarySubtype
desc: Secondary subtype of structure (e.g., Fire Station, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: foundationType
desc: Type of foundation (e.g., Crawl Space not below ground on all sides, Basement below ground on all sides (split-level), Slab on Grade (split level), etc.). [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: buildingSize
desc: Size of building in square feet. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: lotSize
desc: Size of lot in acres. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: yearBuilt
desc: Year the project site inventory was built. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: firstFloorElevation
desc: First Floor Elevation in feet for the project site inventory. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: feetAboveBaseFloodElevation
desc: Number of feet the lowest floor is proposed to be raised above Base Flood Elevation (BFE). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: baseFloodElevation
desc: Based Flood Elevation (BFE) in feet at the project site inventory location. For more information on BFE, seehttps://www.fema.gov/node/404233. Values of -9999 are equivalent to null. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: floodZone
desc: Flood Zone at the project site inventory location. For more information on Flood Zones, seehttps://www.fema.gov/glossary/flood-zones. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: estimatedPurchasePrice
desc: Estimated amount in U.S. dollars to mitigate the project site inventory. As a user entered field, the value can be $0. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: proposedLandUse
desc: Proposed land use post mitigation (e.g., Park, Wetland, Vacant Land, Other, etc.). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: currentlyRented
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is currently rented. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source FEMA GO]

name: criticalFacility
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is a critical facility identified by subapplicant/subrecipient's hazard mitigation plan. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source FEMA GO]

name: alternateStructure
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is an alternate structure. All properties to be mitigated must be identified, including alternate properties that may be substituted should a property be withdrawn. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: substantiallyDamaged
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is substantially damaged. The term 'substantial damage' applies to a structure in a Special Flood Hazard Area or floodplain for which the total cost of repairs is 50 percent or more of the structures market value before the disaster occurred, regardless of the cause of damage. This percentage rule can vary among jurisdictions. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: publiclyOwned
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is publicly owned. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source FEMA GO]

name: insured
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is insured. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: insuranceType
desc: Type of insurance covering the Project Site Inventory (i.e., NFIP Insurance, Private Insurance, Self-Insured). Multiple insurance types are possible and delimited by a semicolon. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: repetitiveLossStructure
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is a Repetitive Loss Structure. For more information on Repetitive Loss Structures as defined by Hazard Mitigation Assistance, seehttps://www.fema.gov/grants/mitigation/hazard-mitigation-assistance-guidance. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: severeRepetitiveLossStructure
desc: Indicates if the project site inventory is a Severe Repetitive Loss Structure. For more information on Repetitive Loss Structures as defined by Hazard Mitigation Assistance, seehttps://www.fema.gov/grants/mitigation/hazard-mitigation-assistance-guidance. Yes is indicated with either a 'true' or '1'. No is indicated with either a 'false' or '0'. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: costEffectivenessMethod
desc: Method used to evaluate the project site inventory's cost-effectiveness (e.g., FEMA BCA Toolkit, pre-calculated benefits, other BCA methodology approved by FEMA). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: preCalculatedBenefit
desc: Type of pre-calculated benefit used to determine the project site inventory's cost-effectiveness (e.g., Acquisitions in the special flood hazard area, Residential hurricane wind retrofits, etc.). For more information on pre-calculated benefits, seehttps://www.fema.gov/grants/guidance-tools/benefit-cost-analysis/streamlined-bca#pre-calculated-benefits. [Source: FEMA GO]

name: benefitCostRatio
desc: Numerical expression of the cost-effectiveness of the project site inventory. The Benefit-Cost Ratio (BCR) is derived from a project site inventory's total net benefits divided by its total cost. [Source: FEMA GO, eGrants, NEMIS]

name: ownerType
desc: Type of owner (e.g., Business, Corporation, Estate/Trust, Government, Individual, Nonprofit, Religious Institution, Tribal). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: coownerType
desc: Type of co-owner (e.g., Business, Corporation, Estate/Trust, Government, Individual, Nonprofit, Religious Institution, Tribal). [Source: FEMA GO]

name: id
desc: Unique ID assigned to the record.
